text: 插件热度榜是面向 DSH Web 界面的插件发现与安装面板。它在设置页和插件页提供热度榜入口，从市场目录读取插件信息，并按 GitHub 收藏数分组排序，也可按近 30 天下载量或名称排序。用户可以搜索插件名称、包名、描述和分类，查看版本与运行环境提示、筛选分类和隐藏已安装项目；符合收录门槛的插件还能从卡片发起安装。插件会定期刷新目录，并保留一段时间内曾达到门槛的条目。运行时会访问 awesome-dsh-plugin.com 和 registry.npmjs.org 获取目录及包元数据，不需要额外 API 密钥。

Star Radar adds a DSH web panel for discovering and installing plugins. Browse by GitHub stars, downloads, or name; filter categories and hide installed items. It refreshes a catalog and shows npm environment notes. It contacts awesome-dsh-plugin.com and registry.npmjs.org; no API key is required.
想在 DSH 里按 GitHub 收藏数和 npm 下载量找插件。
能不能在插件列表里搜索名称、分类，再按下载量排序？
I want to browse, compare, and install DSH plugins from a searchable popularity board.
插件热度榜的功能「搜索和排序」：在 DSH 插件面板中按名称、包名、描述或分类关键词搜索，并按收藏数、近 30 天下载量或名称排序。
插件热度榜的功能「查看并安装插件」：插件卡片展示目录条目和环境信息，用户可从页面发起安装；服务优先调用宿主插件管理器，必要时使用 profile 的包管理器。
插件热度榜会向 awesome-dsh-plugin.com 请求市场目录，并向 registry.npmjs.org 请求已收录包的 latest 元数据，用于展示插件热度和环境提示；源码未声明 API 密钥配置。

dsh-plugin-star-radar README · Plugin Star Radar · dsh-plugin-star-radar：A "what should I install?" reference for people new to DeepSeek Harness (DSH).

It answers one question: **which DSH plugins are people actually paying attention to and installing?**

dsh-plugin-star-radar README · Why two metrics：| Downloads only | Stars only | Both |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Older plugins get pushed out by newer download spikes and become hard to find | A brand-new plugin that is installed in bulk but not starred yet is missed | What people keep watching *and* what gets installed right now |

Inclusion is the **union**; ranking is stars-first. A plugin that cools down stays on the page, which is exactly what a reference list needs.

dsh-plugin-star-radar README · Desktop (recommended)：Settings → Plugins → Install, then paste:

```
dsh-plugin-star-radar
```

Or press the **安装 / Install** button on any card in this plugin.

dsh-plugin-star-radar README · CLI：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-star-radar
```

dsh-plugin-star-radar README · Local checkout：```bash
pnpm add "file:D:/path/to/dsh-plugin-star-radar"
```

Add `"dsh-plugin-star-radar"` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile's `package.json`, then restart DSH.

> Migrating from the older `dsh-plugin-radar` / `dsh-plugin-download-radar`? Disable and remove the old one first — all three register the same section id (`plugin-radar`), so only one may be enabled.

dsh-plugin-star-radar README · Configuration：In the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: plugin-radar
  config:
    minStars: 3000
    minDownloads: 100000

dsh-plugin-star-radar README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `minStars` | `3000` | star count that gets a plugin listed |
| `minDownloads` | `100000` | 30-day download count that gets a plugin listed |
| `retainDays` | `180` | days a plugin stays visible after falling below both thresholds |
| `intervalHours` | `6` | background refresh interval (1–168) |
| `catalogTtlHours` | `12` | market index cache |
| `metaTtlHours` | `24` | npm manifest cache |
| `maxManifest` | `80` | how many manifests feed the environment notes |
| `manifestBudgetMs` | `90000` | manifest phase budget; overruns are skipped, never block the board |
| `catalogUrl` / `npmRegistry` | official | point them at a mirror if needed |
| `dataDir` | `<profile>/.dsh-plugin-radar` | cache directory |

dsh-plugin-star-radar README · Where the data comes from：| Data | Source |
| --- | --- |
| plugin list, GitHub stars, 30-day downloads, category, description, icon | `https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/plugins.json` — **one** request for everything |
| Node/DSH ranges, `os`/`cpu`, install scripts, package size | `https://registry.npmjs.org/<pkg>/latest`, only for listed plugins |

Two deliberate choices:

dsh-plugin-star-radar README · Where the data comes from：1. **No per-package npm downloads history calls.** `api.npmjs.org/downloads/range` answers HTTP 429 under bursts, which is what made an earlier version of this plugin stall mid-refresh. One catalog request cannot rate-limit itself.
2. **Manifest reads are optional and budgeted.** Missing notes never block the board.

dsh-plugin-star-radar README · Development：```bash
node scripts/build-client.mjs      # client.css + client.src.js -> client.js
node --test "test/*.test.mjs"      # offline unit tests
node scripts/live-check.mjs        # real market index, prints the board
dsh-plugin-star-radar README · Publishing：There is no official DSH marketplace; community indexes fill the gap. See [docs/publishing.md](./docs/publishing.md).
